messages:
sara: Anyone else seeing a latency tail after the token-mapper rollout? p95 jumped ~220ms on v3-mapper-2 after 03:00 UTC. Routing fallbacks to slower kernels increased.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: deployed v3-mapper-2 -> prod at 02:57 UTC :rocket:

tom: saw it, p50 is flat but p95/p99 are up. Correlated with requests where seq_len > 1024.

diane: Profiled one affected host (h12). Kernel selection logs show a lot of fallbacks to generic_attention for long sequences. KV cache hit rate dropped to ~48% on those hosts.

kevin: Interesting — tokenizer change might be increasing token counts for certain scripts. @nora can you pull the tokenizer diff and token-length hist?

nora: Diff is small but enough to bump token counts in edge cases. Quick sample: ```
old: "你好世界" -> tokens [722,819] len=2
new: "你好 世界" -> tokens [722,500,819] len=3
```

tom: That extra token can push inputs past the KV pre-warm threshold and change batching paths. Our batching heuristic currently estimates seq distribution from a stale sampler.

sara: Captured kernel selection snippet from h12: ```
[2026-03-16T03:08:12Z] request_id=abc kernel_select: seq_len=1108 chosen=generic_attention score_opt=0.42 score_generic=0.87 reason="opt_score_below_threshold" latency_est=310ms
[2026-03-16T03:08:12Z] request_id=def kernel_select: seq_len=64 chosen=optimized_attention score_opt=0.92
```

kevin: Which tenants were hitting h12? GPU mem usage spiked to 92% and we saw context-switch bursts. Might be noisy neighbor.

diane: I correlated perf counters: tenant-id=alpha-7 qps spike aligns with the p95 spike window. Also saw async memcpy stalls on h12.

nora: Mitigation: rolled v3-mapper-2 back on the canary pool, p95 dropped back to baseline within 8 minutes. Suggestion: we should add a kernel-selection safety guard and tighten the tokenizer rollout checks.

kevin: I'll prepare a hotfix: adjust batching heuristic to cap max batch seq at 1536 and force-split sequences >1024 into the long-path queue to avoid misrouting into generic kernels. Opening PR now.

sara: Action items: add token-length histogram to the tokenizer CI, alert on KV cache hit-rate < 60% per host, and an alert for kernel_fallback_rate > 2% per minute. Filing tickets.

diane: Summarized plan: (1) complete canary rollback (done), (2) telemetry updates (diane), (3) batching guard PR (kevin), (4) tokenizer mapping test and back-compat check (nora).

tom: Also please add kernel_select_reason to sampled traces so we can see why paths changed for real traffic.

sara: Closing loop for now. If rollback holds for 24h we'll avoid a formal postmortem, otherwise we'll run one. Thanks all :+1:
